Starting from FastGPT v4.8.16, commercial edition users can import from Yuque datasets by configuring a Yuque token and uid. This feature is currently in beta — some interactions may still need refinement.

## 1. Get the Yuque Token and UID

Go to the Yuque homepage > click your avatar > Settings to find the relevant parameters.



Follow the images below to get the Token and User ID. Make sure to assign the appropriate permissions to the Token:

**Personal Edition**:

1. In Settings, open **Token** under **Developer**, then create a new token.
2. Enter a purpose for the token and select **Read your knowledge bases** and **Read your documents**. Confirm creation and copy the token.
3. For the UID, use the account identifier shown below your display name and avatar in Settings.

| Get Token                       | Add Permissions                 | Get User ID                     |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| ![Yuque token management](/imgs/optimized/image-33.png.webp) | ![Create a token with read permissions](/imgs/optimized/image-34.png.webp) | ![Yuque account UID in Settings](/imgs/optimized/image-35.png.webp) |

**Enterprise Edition**:

Open **Team Management → Developer → Token** to manage tokens. Token availability depends on your Yuque plan. For the team UID, open the team homepage and copy the first path segment after the domain: in `https://tenant.yuque.com/<team-id>`, use `<team-id>`.

| Get Token                        | Get User ID                      |
| -------------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| ![Enterprise token management](/imgs/optimized/image-109.png.webp) | ![Team UID in the Yuque homepage URL](/imgs/optimized/image-108.png.webp) |

## 2. Create the Dataset

Using the token and uid from the previous step, create a Dataset. Select the **Yuque Dataset** type, fill in the parameters, and click Create.

![2. Create the Dataset — interface example](/imgs/optimized/image-37.png.webp)

![2. Create the Dataset — interface example](/imgs/optimized/current/yuque-dataset-create.png.webp)

## 3. Import Documents

After creating the Dataset, click `Import` to import from your Yuque document library and follow the on-screen guidance.

The Yuque Dataset supports scheduled and manual sync: enable the scheduled sync toggle in the right-side dataset info panel (commercial edition, disabled by default) so the system scans and syncs existing collections daily, or click `Sync data` in a collection's action menu to trigger a manual sync.

![Select Yuque documents to import](/imgs/optimized/image-38.png.webp)
